The hero Xin Wu. The traitor Xin Wu. The [Defier of Fate] Xin Wu. His destiny was written long ago in the Book of Prophecy, decreeing that he would bring ruin to Cathay. For this, Cathay became his enemy, and the Four Gods granted him their blessing. He was meant to bring total destruction upon Cathay amid its division and strife, yet as a mere mortal he defied both fate and the Four Gods, bringing salvation to Cathay in his own way... And yet, this is not the end of Xin Wu's story.
Xin Wu has once again slipped free of death's grasp, yet this time he will heed the will of Qing Bao Tian Zun and bring the fated ruin upon Cathay.

Time cannot be reversed, and the past cannot be undone. The flames of remorse gnaw endlessly at Xin Wu's body and soul.

Whispers of the Spirit Raven
The whispers of the Spirit Raven echo endlessly in Xin Wu's ears, granting him transcendent wisdom, while driving to madness all others who hear them.
Blazing Blood, Radiant Flame
With every beat of Xin Wu's heart, scalding blood surges from the wound at his neck, blazing into radiant flame. Wherever this fire passes, all is reduced to ash.
Art of a Hundred Battles

The memories of a mortal general stir once more in Xin Wu's mind, and he recalls the art of commanding armies... though his head was severed by his own cursed blade, and not even the might of the Four Gods can rejoin it.
